वैजनन (नं) 1.
n. The last month of
uterine gestation.

वैजयन्त (न्तः) 1.
m. The palace of
Indra, his banner.
f. न्ती A flag;
a garland; name of two trees.

वैजयन्तिक (कः) 1.
m. A flag-bearer.
1.
f. A flag; name of a tree.

वैजयि (यिः) 2.
m. Third emperor of
the
Jainas.

वैजात्य (त्यं) 1.
n. Difference of caste
or conduct, exclusion from caste.

वैजिक (कः-की-कं)
n. Cause, cause
of existence, the soul; an oil.
m. A young shoot.
a. Seminal.
